title: Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (FCX) and Digital Realty Trust, Inc. (DLR) Highlight the Companies Cashing In on AI Infrastructure
excerpt: Big tech companies are spending close to $700 billion this year building AI data centers. Most of the attention goes to chipmakers like Nvidia. However, two...
content_html:
Fatima Gulzar

Sun, July 26, 2026 at 3:47 AM PDT 6 min read

Big tech companies are spending close to $700 billion this year building AI data centers. Most of the attention goes to chipmakers like Nvidia. However, two very different companies just reported earnings that show how much money is flowing to businesses that don't make a single chip: a copper miner and a company that owns and rents out the buildings data centers sit in.

Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX): Copper Prices Are Doing the Heavy Lifting

Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) beat expectations. The copper mining giant earned 74 cents a share, excluding one-time costs, versus the 59 cents analysts expected. Regular profit, i.e., net income, came in at $984 million, or 68 cents a share, up from 53 cents a share a year ago. Here's the twist, though: the firm actually mined 18.2% less copper this quarter, not more. So the beat came from price, not volume. The average price of copper rose 41.5% from a year earlier, driven by supply worries and strong demand from China.

Freeport's production dropped because its Grasberg mine in Indonesia, the second-largest copper mine in the world, is still recovering from a deadly mud flow disaster last September that killed seven workers and shut the mine down for weeks. Repair costs alone were about $363 million this quarter. CEO Kathleen Quirk said the mine's recovery is "on track" and still expects it to reopen fully by the end of the year. There's also a possible bonus ahead: the Trump administration has been expected to announce a tariff on copper, which would likely boost Freeport's profits further, though no decision has come yet. The stock actually fell 2.3% the morning results came out, roughly in line with the rest of the market that day.

Copper itself is worth understanding here. It's one of the best materials for conducting electricity, and it's used worldwide in motors, computers, batteries, and wiring. As AI infrastructure keeps getting built, copper demand is expected to stay strong for years, even if this particular quarter's beat came mostly from price, not from a sudden AI-driven buying spree.

Digital Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE:DLR): Getting Paid Rent by the AI Boom Directly

Digital Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE:DLR)'s quarter shows a much more direct link to AI spending. The company owns and leases out data centers, and this quarter its revenue jumped 29% to $1.92 billion, blowing past the $1.66 billion analysts expected. Its main cash flow number, Core FFO, came in at $2.65 a share versus the $1.86 expected, though that figure includes $188 million in one-time income from a joint-venture development deal. The more comparable number was $2.13 a share, still up from $1.87 a year ago. The firm raised full-year guidance and now expects $8.15 to $8.20 a share for the year, up from $8 to $8.10, and raised its revenue forecast too. New leases signed in July alone are worth $410 million a year in rent at full value, though Digital Realty's own share of that, since some properties are jointly owned, is $205 million. When existing tenants renewed their leases this quarter, Digital Realty raised the rent by over 25%, a sign of just how much pricing power it has right now. The company also just closed a $3.5 billion deal to buy a bigger stake in three data centers in Northern Virginia, the world's largest data center market, from investment firm Blackstone.

法蒂玛·古尔扎尔

大型科技公司今年花费近 7000 亿美元建设人工智能数据中心。 大多数注意力都集中在像英伟达这样的芯片制造商身上。 然而，两家截然不同的公司刚刚公布了财报，显示有多少资金流向了不生产芯片的企业：一家是铜矿开采商，另一家是拥有并出租数据中心所在建筑的公司。

自由港麦克莫兰公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FCX）：铜价正在发挥重要作用

自由港麦克莫兰公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FCX）超出预期。 不计一次性成本，这家铜矿巨头每股盈利 74 美分，而分析师预期为 59 美分。 常规利润（即净利润）为 9.84 亿美元，即每股 68 美分，高于一年前的每股 53 美分。 但问题是：该公司本季度的铜开采量实际上减少了 18.2%，而不是更多。 因此，竞争来自于价格，而不是数量。 受供应担忧和中国强劲需求的推动，铜均价同比上涨41.5%。

自由港的产量下降是因为其位于印度尼西亚的 Grasberg 矿是世界第二大铜矿，该矿仍在从去年 9 月发生的致命泥石流灾难中恢复，这场灾难导致 7 名工人死亡，矿场关闭了数周。 本季度仅维修成本就约为 3.63 亿美元。 首席执行官凯瑟琳·奎克 (Kathleen Quirk) 表示，该矿的恢复“步入正轨”，并仍预计在今年年底前全面重新开放。 未来还有一个可能的好处：预计特朗普政府将宣布对铜征收关税，这可能会进一步提高自由港的利润，尽管尚未做出决定。 早间业绩公布后，该股实际上下跌了 2.3%，与当天市场的其余部分大致一致。

铜本身就值得在这里了解一下。 它是最好的导电材料之一，在全球范围内用于电机、计算机、电池和电线。 随着人工智能基础设施的不断建设，铜需求预计将在未来几年保持强劲，即使这个特定季度的增长主要来自价格，而不是来自突然的人工智能驱动的购买热潮。

Digital Realty Trust, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：DLR）：通过人工智能热潮直接支付租金

Digital Realty Trust, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：DLR）的季度显示与人工智能支出有更直接的联系。 该公司拥有并出租数据中心，本季度其收入增长 29% 至 19.2 亿美元，超出分析师预期的 16.6 亿美元。 其主要现金流量核心 FFO 为每股 2.65 美元，而预期为 1.86 美元，不过该数字包括来自合资开发交易的 1.88 亿美元一次性收入。 更具可比性的数字为每股 2.13 美元，仍高于一年前的 1.87 美元。 该公司上调了全年指引，目前预计今年每股收益从 8 美元上调至 8.10 美元，至 8.15 美元至 8.20 美元，并上调了收入预测。 仅在 7 月份签署的新租约就按全额租金计算每年价值 4.1 亿美元，但由于部分房产是共同拥有，Digital Realty 自己的份额为 2.05 亿美元。 当现有租户本季度续租时，Digital Realty 将租金提高了 25% 以上，这表明它目前拥有强大的定价能力。 该公司还刚刚完成了一项价值 35 亿美元的交易，从投资公司 Blackstone 手中购买了全球最大数据中心市场北弗吉尼亚州三个数据中心的更多股份。
